CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2830 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head d4f71c00acdedb70f9fcdbf619030a7766b76d04. Bus nonce: 1abe0df0de65243670104e7a434fb71f. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin d4f71c00acdedb70f9fcdbf619030a7766b76d04`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge d4f71c00acdedb70f9fcdbf619030a7766b76d04` or `Fix review: blocked d4f71c00acdedb70f9fcdbf619030a7766b76d04 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 1abe0df0de65243670104e7a434fb71f`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `d4f71c00acdedb70f9fcdbf619030a7766b76d04` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2830 d4f71c00acdedb70f9fcdbf619030a7766b76d04") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2830-1abe0df0`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA review of #2830 (triage batch 30, dev/programme/triage/s6-batch30.md, rulings P168-P175) at the re-cut head, against dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md and dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. The previous head was blocked; the blocked verdict is attached below. THE RULE TRIAGE APPLIES, which you check on every ruling: an unmeasured benefit is DEFER; an ACCEPT stands only when it is (a) measured (the Instances: field carries the command or log reference beside each figure and you re-derive at least one), (b) measure-first (the destination group's first step is the measurement, with a removal criterion), or (c) a trial with a named measurement and a removal criterion. An even trade is REJECT. For each finding in the attached verdict, say whether the re-cut closed it, with the line that does. Re-check every ruling's Source:, Instances:, Cost:, Binding: and that every ACCEPT names a destination group that is LIVE on the roster at origin/main (exists, not done, not absorbed, not merging or in the train spool); a DEFER names a group that is not done or absorbed; a ruling that re-cuts an earlier one cites it; no ruling duplicates another or an existing group. Check the body's verdict figures against the file, that the pull request changes only the batch file and its delivery row, and that no host or home path appears. Report a ruling you would change, with the evidence, and say merge or blocked.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.

## Block

Contract: `dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md` (current: no diff to origin/main under `dev/governance/roles/`): "an unmeasured benefit is DEFER, never ACCEPT"; "ACCEPT names its destination"; "DEFER names what would change the answer, or the group already owning the item". The same shape was blocked one batch earlier: batch 28 (#2828, head 9f76c0978), verdict on probe/rev-2828-343e3839, "verdict-word: P152-P157 ACCEPT an unmeasured benefit" (ev/sibling_verdicts.txt). Batch 30 repeats it.

1. **P169, P170, P173, P174: ACCEPT on a benefit the file says is unmeasured.** Each one's `Instances:` reads "none measured" (P169, P173, P174) or names a mechanism with no count (P170: "the train's own recarry is the step it replaces", with no count of recarries a background refresh would have saved). P174's own Binding says "unscored, it adds a step of unknown yield", and P170's says "it pays only with V74's cache and the merge-queue decision", which is a statement of what would change the answer. Re-cut each as DEFER naming that measurement: P169, the rounds a shadow would have saved on L/XL groups (the 2.26 rounds-per-PR population split by size); P170, the recarries per merge from the train logs and the cache hit rate once P153 exists; P173, block reasons a scaffold would have prevented, by kind; P174, the rubric's scored yield against real verdicts.
2. **P172 and P175: ACCEPT to "D13" on an unmeasured benefit.** Both price only the cost (S, XS). P172's Binding says "the Pareto pays from round 11's first wave" and P175's "it tells round 11 which brief source to repair first": a promise, not a measurement. D13 is a dimension brief, not a roster group, so "under D13" is no ACCEPT destination either; the only routed destination is the single carry to R10-ROUND-PLAYBOOK under P175. DEFER, or take the owner-sourced route below.
3. **P168: the ACCEPTed half is itself the measurement.** "ACCEPT narrowed -> round-11 measurement item", with `Instances:` "no per-script failure probability is recorded in the tree" and Binding "no saving without data". That is DEFER naming what changes the answer (p(red)/runtime per script from check-run history). The REJECT of the cancel half is sound and should stay a REJECT, preferably on its own `Verdict:` line so `ruling_verdict` does not read the whole entry as ACCEPT (it does: ev/ruling_verdict.txt).
4. **P171: "ACCEPT narrowed ... no new round-10 carry".** Every arm is owned elsewhere (R10-FLOW-JIDOKA carries 11 and 18, `prepr.sh:1417`, `prepr.sh:278`, P135 -> R10-ORCH-REVIEW-PACKET) or waits on P172. The contract's word for that is DEFER -> the owning group, as the batch-28 verdict said of P150/P151 and the batch-29 verdict of P166.

The owner's acceptance of the ideas ("tvofi-accepted T4, T9, T10, F2-F5, F7") can still reach R10-ROUND-PLAYBOOK as an owner-sourced carry citing tvofi, the route the playbook's carry index 1 ("Round-11 decision item (tvofi, 2026-10-25 ...)") took; it should not go through a triage ACCEPT the contract forbids.

## Findings

- **P175's figure "round 10's overall first-pass yield is 38/71 = 0.54 (plan-opt flow_metrics)" carries a number without its command or window.** The contract: "each counted instance with the command or log reference beside its figure: cite it, don't carry it". I could not re-derive it. `tools/audit/seat/flow_metrics.py` over round 10 (roster's first commit 2026-10-15T12:37:57Z to 2026-10-25T19:00Z) gives 117/255 (0.46); 2026-10-24..: 31/65 (0.48); no window I tried gives 38/71 (ev/flow_metrics_windows.txt). "Overall" is therefore contradicted by the tool at the round-10 window. State the window and command, or drop "overall". Carry: dismissed: rides the re-cut this verdict requires
- **Figures carried with no command or log reference:** P168 "median 1.45 h to 2.35 h" per review round; P169 "2.26 (plan-opt, n=110)"; P170 "PR run wall median 920 s" and "mean in-flight 10.4"; P172 "63 blocks; 16 real, at least 14 mechanical, 14 carry-missing" (and R10-FLOW-JIDOKA's brief counts "133 blocked fix reviews ... 25 carry-missing", so the window matters). None is found in the tree (`git grep` over `dev tools`); "plan-opt" is a seat, not a command. Cite the command or the log beside each, or drop it. Carry: dismissed: rides the re-cut this verdict requires
- **Rulings lean on rulings that are not on main and whose PRs are blocked.** P168 cites P158 / R10-PROOF-CODEQL (#2829, blocked on probe/rev-2829-94a1c859; the group is on the roster ref 32ffe43c0 but not on origin/main), P170 cites P153 (#2828, blocked), P174 cites V94 "ruled in batch 31" (P176, #2831 open). A re-cut should name the dependency as open, not settled. Carry: dismissed: rides the re-cut this verdict requires
- **Two citations point beside their claim.** P168 "`ci.yml:254`, `gate` needs the units": line 254 is `pr-contract`'s `needs`; `gate` (ci.yml:301-302) needs only `prelude, pr-contract`. The parallelism point holds (every unit job `needs: prelude`, ci.yml:169-241). P169 "`fix-review.md:3-4`" holds fresh context and the head worktree but not "the finder's harness, never the fixer's", which is step 2 (lines 13-14). Re-anchor in the re-cut. Carry: dismissed: rides the re-cut this verdict requires
